_doc: Hand-to-gun contracts shared by the Blender grip pass (combatant_grip_pass.py) and the runtime (src/engine/mannequin/combatantWeaponGrip.ts, src/engine/combat/sidearmFistGrip.ts). Gun frame: barrel -Z, top +Y, its right +X, metres. Right hand; the left hand is the mirror (x negated, quaternion y and z negated). tests/weaponGripContract.test.ts keeps the TypeScript constants equal to these.

long_gun._doc: Baked on the M4A1 with the support palm a little past the reach of the shotgun's pump from its trigger (0.318 m), the farthest of the three guns, so the runtime support IK only ever pulls the hand a few centimetres back or across onto the M4 handguard, the pump or the sniper forend, which an arm can always do.
